description: Hidrovias Minas Gerais is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Trechos dos rios navegáveis considerados na categoria de hidrovias do Estado de Mi-nas Gerais. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are 0404_mg_hidrovias_lin, Hidrovia, Rio, Minas Gerais. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
